text: For a long time: no servant will stay, and Helen and Julia do all the work of the house
why: ¶28 states no servant would stay and that for a long time Helen and Julia did all the work of the house.

text: Before this morning: Julia dies, aged thirty
why: ¶28 says Julia was but thirty at the time of her death, told in the past tense, so it happened before this morning.
